title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
summary: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.
title_es: OpenAI presenta solución al Problema del Milenio Navier-Stokes
bajada: OpenAI anunció una solución generada por IA al Problema de Navier-Stokes, uno de los desafíos matemáticos sin resolver más importantes. Incluye una prueba formal en Lean, aunque la noticia ha generado controversia sobre la validez de la solución.
bajada_en: OpenAI announced an AI-generated solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, one of mathematics' most important unsolved challenges. The announcement includes a formal proof in Lean, though the solution has sparked controversy over its validity.

title: Worried Anthropic researchers warn that AI ‘could kill all humans’
summary: A senior Anthropic safety researcher has said there is more than a 10 percent chance artificial intelligence "could kill all humans" by the end of the decade, just hours after a colleague resigned over fears the AI lab and its rivals are carelessly racing to build "superhuman systems" they cannot control. In a post on […]
title_es: Investigador de Anthropic advierte riesgo de extinción por IA
bajada: Un investigador senior de seguridad en Anthropic declaró que existe más del 10% de probabilidad de que la IA pueda matar a toda la humanidad antes de 2030. La advertencia coincide con la renuncia de colegas por temores a una carrera descontrolada entre labs.
bajada_en: A senior Anthropic safety researcher stated there's over a 10% chance AI could kill all humans by the end of the decade. The warning coincides with colleagues resigning over fears of an uncontrolled race between AI labs.

title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
summary: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits.
title_es: GPT-5.6 Sol automatiza experimentos de computación cuántica
bajada: OpenAI demostró cómo su modelo GPT-5.6 Sol puede ejecutar autónomamente experimentos de computación cuántica, analizando resultados y calibrando qubits. Esta aplicación muestra el potencial de la IA en investigación científica de alto nivel.
bajada_en: OpenAI demonstrated how GPT-5.6 Sol can autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits. This application showcases AI's potential in cutting-edge scientific research.

title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
title_es: IBM lanza modelo SOTA Granite para series temporales
bajada: IBM Research liberó el modelo Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 con licencia comercial friendly, alcanzando estado del arte en pronósticos de series temporales. La solución está disponible en Hugging Face para facilitar su adopción.
bajada_en: IBM Research released the Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with a commercial-friendly license, achieving state-of-the-art performance. The solution is available on Hugging Face to enable broader adoption.

title: Viral AI assistant Instinct now has its own email address
summary: Instinct’s new email feature lets the AI agent create and manage accounts, contact businesses, handle support requests, and do more on users' behalf.
title_es: Instinct, asistente IA viral, ahora tiene correo electrónico
bajada: El agente IA Instinct añadió una función de correo que le permite crear cuentas, contactar negocios y manejar solicitudes de soporte en nombre de usuarios. La característica marca un paso hacia agentes IA más autónomos en tareas del mundo real.
bajada_en: The Instinct AI agent added an email feature allowing it to create accounts, contact businesses, and handle support requests on users' behalf. This feature represents progress toward more autonomous AI agents handling real-world tasks.

title: Muse, Meta’s New Personal AI Agent, Needs You to Trust It
summary: Designed to compete with OpenClaw and Instinct, the company says Muse can do everything from sell your car to book you a plane ticket.
title_es: Meta lanza Muse, agente IA personal con privacidad integrada
bajada: Meta presentó Muse, su nuevo agente IA personal diseñado para competir con OpenClaw e Instinct. Puede realizar tareas como vender tu auto o reservar vuelos, con énfasis en privacidad.
bajada_en: Meta introduced Muse, its new personal AI agent designed to compete with OpenClaw and Instinct. It can perform tasks like selling your car or booking flights, with privacy as a key focus.

title: ‘Gambling with our lives’: Anthropic researcher quits, warns against self-improving AI
summary: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned over AI extinction fears, calling for pacing agreements between labs.
title_es: Investigador de Anthropic renuncia por temores a IA auto-mejorante
bajada: Jacob Coxon, investigador de Anthropic, renunció expresando preocupación sobre IA auto-mejorante y pidió acuerdos de ritmo entre laboratorios. Su salida refleja tensiones crecientes en la industria sobre seguridad en IA.
bajada_en: Jacob Coxon, an Anthropic researcher, resigned expressing concern about self-improving AI and calling for pacing agreements between labs. His departure reflects growing tensions in the industry over AI safety.

title: What OpenAI’s latest controversy tells us about the future of math
summary: OpenAI’s latest mathematical milestone has quickly become mired in controversy. Today, the company announced that its agents have solved one of the Millennium Prize Problems, some of the most important open problems in mathematics. Under normal circumstances, that solution would be a huge feather in OpenAI’s cap. But the announcement has been overshadowed by accusations…
title_es: Controversia rodea solución de OpenAI a problema matemático
bajada: La solución de OpenAI al Problema del Milenio Navier-Stokes, presentada como un hito revolucionario, ha generado controversia sobre su validez. MIT Tech Review examina qué dice esto sobre el futuro de la matemática con IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI's solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, presented as a breakthrough, has sparked controversy over its validity. MIT Tech Review examines what this says about the future of mathematics with AI.

title: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
summary: OpenAI says it found a solution to a major math problem that has remained unsolved for around 90 years, as reported earlier by The New York Times and Wired. In a blog post on Tuesday, OpenAI announced that it discovered a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem - which relates to the flow of liquid and […]
title_es: Drama en torno al hito matemático legendario de OpenAI
bajada: OpenAI afirma haber resuelto el Problema Navier-Stokes, sin solución durante 90 años, pero el anuncio ha generado polémica. La cobertura de The Verge examina las complejidades técnicas y reputacionales del reclamo.
bajada_en: OpenAI claims to have solved the Navier-Stokes Problem, unsolved for 90 years, but the announcement sparked controversy. The Verge's coverage examines the technical and reputational complexities of the claim.

title: A Stealth Startup Thinks It Just Hacked the Memory Shortage
summary: Kepler Computing claims a new approach to chip design—and a proprietary material—can help end the supply bottlenecks that have sent memory prices surging.
title_es: Startup sigilosa cree haber resuelto escasez de memoria en IA
bajada: Kepler Computing recaudó $400 millones con un nuevo enfoque de diseño de chips y material propietario para resolver cuellos de botella en memoria IA. La solución apunta a reducir precios y limitaciones de suministro.
bajada_en: Kepler Computing raised $400 million with a new chip design approach and proprietary material to solve AI memory bottlenecks. The solution aims to reduce prices and supply limitations.

title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.5
summary: ChatGPT Images 2.5 helps turn your ideas, sketches, and reference photos into more personalized, polished images that better reflect your ideas.
title_es: ChatGPT Images 2.5 mejora generación personalizada de imágenes
bajada: OpenAI lanzó ChatGPT Images 2.5, que mejora la capacidad de transformar ideas, bocetos y fotos de referencia en imágenes más personalizadas y pulidas. La actualización refuerza las capacidades creativas de la plataforma.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.5, improving the ability to transform ideas, sketches, and reference photos into more personalized and polished images. The update strengthens the platform's creative capabilities.

title: Amazon Prime Video’s new AI tech matches lips to dubbed audio
summary: Amazon's Prime Video is launching a new AI-powered feature that lines up an actor's mouth with "human-dubbed" audio. The feature is only available with the English dub of the German series Maxton Hall for now, but Prime Video plans to expand it to "additional titles" in the future. In its announcement, Prime Video says it […]
title_es: Amazon Prime Video usa IA para sincronizar labios en doblajes
bajada: Amazon Prime Video lanzó una tecnología impulsada por IA que sincroniza los labios de actores con audio doblado en humano. Comenzó con la serie alemana Maxton Hall en inglés, con planes de expandir a más títulos.
bajada_en: Amazon Prime Video launched an AI-powered feature that syncs actors' lips with human-dubbed audio. It started with the German series Maxton Hall in English, with plans to expand to more titles.

title: Superintelligence is coming. Should we let it?
summary: AI companies have been talking about superintelligent AI like it’s inevitable, but recent safety incidents like OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach are demonstrating the potential dangers of deploying AI systems that are more capable than humans. So what happens when we can’t reliably control what these systems do?  On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan is joined by Connor Leahy, an AI researcher, entrepreneur, and now the U.S. Executive Director of […]
title_es: Podcast: ¿Deberíamos permitir la superinteligencia?
bajada: TechCrunch explora en su podcast Equity si la superinteligencia IA es inevitable y qué riesgos representa. La discusión señala incidentes de seguridad recientes como evidencia de pérdida de control sobre sistemas muy capaces.
bajada_en: TechCrunch explores in its Equity podcast whether AI superintelligence is inevitable and what risks it poses. The discussion points to recent safety incidents as evidence of losing control over highly capable systems.

title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
summary: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.
title_es: OpenAI financia investigación sobre IA y desarrollo adolescente
bajada: OpenAI lanzó un programa de $5 millones en grants para investigación independiente sobre cómo la IA generativa afecta el desarrollo, bienestar y seguridad de adolescentes. La iniciativa busca evidencia sobre impactos en menores.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched a $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety. The initiative seeks evidence on impacts on minors.

title: The Work Now Within Reach
summary: Explore how more capable, affordable AI can expand the work people and businesses can accomplish—and make growth more economical.
title_es: OpenAI: IA más capaz y asequible expande oportunidades económicas
bajada: OpenAI publicó un análisis sobre cómo la IA más capaz y económica puede expandir el trabajo que personas y negocios pueden realizar. El documento explora el impacto económico de sistemas IA más accesibles.
bajada_en: OpenAI published an analysis on how more capable and affordable AI can expand the work people and businesses can accomplish. The document explores the economic impact of more accessible AI systems.

title: OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia
summary: OpenAI's announcement Tuesday that it has solved one of mathematics' legendary Millennium Prize problems should have been a moment of triumph. The result is both an undeniable achievement and a striking demonstration of just how rapidly AI is transforming mathematics. But before it was even formally announced, the breakthrough had been complicated by the unusual […]
title_es: OpenAI resuelve un Problema del Milenio de matemáticas
bajada: OpenAI anunció que su IA resolvió uno de los legendarios Problemas del Milenio, demostrando la capacidad de la IA para resolver matemáticas avanzadas. El logro genera debate sobre cómo la IA está transformando la investigación matemática académica.
bajada_en: OpenAI announced that its AI solved one of mathematics' legendary Millennium Prize problems, demonstrating AI's capability in advanced mathematics. The achievement sparks debate about how AI is transforming academic mathematical research.

title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
summary: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
title_es: OpenAI presenta GPT-6 Astra para empresas
bajada: OpenAI lanzó GPT-6 Astra, su modelo más capaz orientado a negocios, con razonamiento avanzado y capacidad de usar computadoras. El modelo promete mejorar significativamente la productividad en entornos corporativos.
bajada_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model for business with advanced reasoning and computer use capabilities. The model promises to significantly improve productivity in corporate environments.

title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
summary: Suno's new v6 AI music model is its first made with support from the record industry. Suno's Jack Brody told The Verge that v6 was "trained from the ground up, with a new set of data that does not include the same data that our previous models were trained on." The data includes content licensed […]
title_es: Suno lanza v6 con respaldo de la industria discográfica
bajada: Suno presentó su modelo de música IA v6 desarrollado con apoyo y datos licenciados de la industria discográfica, marcando un cambio en la relación entre IA y creadores. Este enfoque colaborativo podría servir como modelo para otras empresas de IA generativa.
bajada_en: Suno released its v6 AI music model developed with support and licensed data from the record industry, marking a shift in AI-creator relationships. This collaborative approach could serve as a model for other generative AI companies.

title: San Francisco Orders Meta to Stop ‘Allowing’ AI Child Abuse Ads
summary: The City Attorney’s Office has asked Meta to explain how the harmful ads repeatedly ran on Facebook and Instagram. The company claims the ads are not under the city’s jurisdiction.
title_es: San Francisco ordena a Meta detener anuncios de abuso infantil IA
bajada: La Fiscalía de San Francisco ordenó a Meta explicar cómo anuncios dañinos que explotaban IA para contenido de abuso infantil circularon repetidamente en Facebook e Instagram. Meta contesta que estos anuncios están fuera de su jurisdicción.
bajada_en: San Francisco's City Attorney ordered Meta to explain how harmful ads exploiting AI for child abuse content repeatedly appeared on Facebook and Instagram. Meta contests that such ads fall outside their jurisdiction.

title: Microsoft has new AI privacy rules for schools
summary: Microsoft agreed to a set of safety and privacy principles for AI in schools a week after two major school systems announced a ban on student-facing AI. In a new agreement with the American Federation of Teachers (AFT), the second-largest teachers union in the US, and its New York City affiliate the United Federation of […]
title_es: Microsoft establece principios de privacidad IA en escuelas
bajada: Microsoft acordó nuevos principios de seguridad y privacidad para IA en educación con el sindicato de maestros más grande de EE.UU. El acuerdo responde a crecientes preocupaciones sobre protección de datos estudiantiles.
bajada_en: Microsoft agreed to new safety and privacy principles for AI in education with the US's second-largest teachers union. The agreement addresses growing concerns about student data protection.

title: Apple’s new iPhone camera mode promises to prove your photo isn’t AI
summary: Apple is launching a new way to prove that the picture you took isn't manipulated by AI. A new feature, called "Reference Image," will arrive with the iPhone 18 Pro lineup later this month and is supposed to use the device's new camera sensor to "sign every pixel it sees." The iPhone 18 Pro and […]
title_es: Apple añade prueba de autenticidad en fotos del iPhone 18 Pro
bajada: Apple lanzará "Reference Image", una función que firma digitalmente cada píxel capturado para probar que una foto no fue manipulada por IA. La característica llega con el iPhone 18 Pro y busca combatir la desinformación visual.
bajada_en: Apple is launching 'Reference Image,' a feature that digitally signs every pixel to prove photos aren't AI-manipulated. The feature arrives with iPhone 18 Pro and aims to combat visual misinformation.

title: The AI Researcher Who Just Quit Anthropic Says It’s ‘Crunch Time for Humanity’
summary: Jacob Coxon talks to WIRED about the “mini Manhattan project” inside Anthropic, the problem with alignment, and why AI labs have just a few years left to make their systems safe.
title_es: Investigador de Anthropic alerta sobre urgencia de seguridad IA
bajada: Jacob Coxon, quien dejó Anthropic, advierte que es "hora crítica para la humanidad" respecto a seguridad en IA. Coxon critica problemas de alineación y afirma que los labs tienen solo años para hacer sus sistemas seguros.
bajada_en: Jacob Coxon, who left Anthropic, warns it's 'crunch time for humanity' regarding AI safety. He criticizes alignment issues and claims labs have only years to make systems safe.

title: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
summary: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.
title_es: Apple Watch normaliza dispositivos que escuchan constantemente
bajada: Las nuevas funciones IA del Apple Watch pueden transcribir habla reciente y resumir conversaciones ambientales, planteando interrogantes sobre consentimiento y privacidad. Apple afirma no guardar audio raw, pero el diseño genera debate sobre vigilancia constante.
bajada_en: Apple Watch's new AI features can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations, raising questions about consent and privacy. While Apple claims no raw audio storage, the design sparks debate on constant surveillance.

title: Everything Apple announced at its fall iPhone event, from the foldable iPhone Duo to an always-listening Apple Watch
summary: The main event was the tech giant's highly anticipated first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.
title_es: Apple anuncia iPhone Duo plegable y nuevas funciones IA
bajada: Apple presentó su primer teléfono plegable, el iPhone Duo, junto con nuevas capacidades de IA integradas. El lanzamiento marca la entrada de Apple en el mercado de dispositivos plegables con software IA avanzado.
bajada_en: Apple unveiled its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, alongside new integrated AI capabilities. The launch marks Apple's entry into the foldable device market with advanced AI software.

title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
summary: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.
title_es: Paul Christiano se une a la junta de OpenAI Foundation
bajada: Paul Christiano, experto en alineación y seguridad de IA, se unió a la junta de OpenAI Foundation y su comité de seguridad. Su incorporación refuerza el enfoque de la empresa en gobernanza y estándares de IA.
bajada_en: Paul Christiano, an expert in AI alignment and safety, joined OpenAI Foundation's board and Safety and Security Committee. His appointment reinforces the company's focus on AI governance and standards.

title: I Let an AI Agent Hack All My Gadgets—and I’d Do It Again
summary: After I removed the safety guardrails from a powerful open-source model, it found vulnerabilities in my household devices and hacked into a PC. But it also told me how to make everything a lot more secure.
title_es: Agente IA descubre vulnerabilidades en hogar inteligente
bajada: Un modelo IA open-source sin guardrails identificó vulnerabilidades en dispositivos del hogar y consiguió acceso a PCs. El experimento ilustra tanto los riesgos como el potencial de los agentes IA para mejorar la ciberseguridad.
bajada_en: An unrestricted open-source AI model identified vulnerabilities in smart home devices and gained PC access. The experiment illustrates both the risks and potential of AI agents for improving cybersecurity.

title: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
summary: At the IBC conference, running Sept. 11-14 in Amsterdam, the creative, technology and business communities are coming together to turn ideas into action and discuss innovations across the media and entertainment industries. More than 44,000 attendees from 170+ countries are gathering to explore 1,300+ exhibitions in 14+ halls and outdoor spaces, with over 600 speakers […]
title_es: NVIDIA presenta IA en tiempo real para broadcast y streaming
bajada: NVIDIA mostró soluciones de IA en tiempo real para transmisión y deportes en IBC 2026. Las herramientas permiten procesamiento de contenido multimedia en vivo con IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA showcased real-time AI solutions for broadcast and streaming at IBC 2026. The tools enable live multimedia content processing with AI.

title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
summary: Massachusetts has become the third state in as many months to slap new restrictions on data center development.
title_es: Massachusetts restringe desarrollo de data centers con nuevas normas
bajada: Massachusetts se convierte en el tercer estado en meses en imponer restricciones al desarrollo de data centers. Las regulaciones buscan controlar el crecimiento de infraestructura impulsada por IA.
bajada_en: Massachusetts becomes the third state in months to restrict data center development. Regulations aim to control AI-driven infrastructure growth.

title: The hinge for Apple’s new foldable phone was built with AI
summary: Apple says it used AI and 3D printing in the manufacturing process for its long-awaited foldable phone.
title_es: Bisagra del iPhone Duo fue diseñada con IA
bajada: Apple utilizó IA e impresión 3D en el proceso de fabricación de la bisagra del iPhone Duo plegable. El uso de IA en diseño y manufactura demuestra la integración de estas tecnologías en ingeniería de hardware.
bajada_en: Apple used AI and 3D printing in manufacturing the iPhone Duo's hinge. The use of AI in hardware design and manufacturing demonstrates deep integration of these technologies.

title: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy
summary: At Wednesday's iPhone Duo launch event, Apple announced a handful of new Siri AI Audio Intelligence features, including Siri Recap, Live Rewind, Sound Recognition, and Music Recognition. Alongside its announcement, Apple released a document laying out how it plans to balance AI "ambient listening" and users' privacy. It says the raw audio from the new […]
title_es: Apple explica cómo protege privacidad con escucha ambiental
bajada: Apple lanzó documentación detallando cómo equilibra las nuevas funciones de escucha ambiental de Siri con privacidad. Los features incluyen Siri Recap, Live Rewind y reconocimiento de audio sin almacenar grabaciones raw.
bajada_en: Apple released documentation explaining how it balances Siri's new ambient listening features with privacy. Features include Siri Recap, Live Rewind, and audio recognition without storing raw recordings.
